name: Campingplatz Seehamer See
beschreibung: The Seehamer See campsite is located in the municipality of Weyarn in Tirol, Österreich, directly on the lakeshore. The surroundings are shaped by the Tiroler mountain landscape and the lake itself. The site has pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and well-maintained. A kiosk and a restaurant provide guests with food and refreshments. The Seehamer See is ideal for activities such as swimming, sailing, and surfing. The atmosphere at the site is predominantly quiet and family-friendly. The target audience is therefore primarily families and water sports enthusiasts.
